newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: South Australia to sell its State Print operation.
newsitem.headline: South Australia to sell its State Print operation.

text.p: The South Australian state government said on Friday it would sell its printing service, State Print, operating as SPRINT.
The sale via an advertised tender next month would include a two year supply contract for printing services to several government agencies, Contract Services minister Dean Brown said in a statement.
Brown said the assessment of tenders would include what economic benefits the purchaser would bring to the state and expectations of the number of employees to be retained.
He said SPRINT had made a profit in 1995/96 for the first time in years, but a spokeswoman said the figure would only be made available to those who registered for the tender.
